mobs.Alchemist.description: Someone has to run the stills.
mobs.Alchemist.name: Alchemist

mobs.AlphaScorpion.description: The pack's old matriarch. Its sting carries a venom the small ones have not grown into.
mobs.AlphaScorpion.name: Alpha Scorpion

mobs.AlphaYeti.description: The biggest of the cave. The ground shakes when it lands a blow.
mobs.AlphaYeti.name: Alpha Yeti

mobs.Beholder.description: The storm's eye. It mends the Guthulim around it and drives them on.
mobs.Beholder.name: Beholder

mobs.BoarRider.description: A goblin on a war boar. The boar does the thinking.
mobs.BoarRider.name: Boar Rider

mobs.Bullfrog.description: The slaad's great frog. It hops, and it bites.
mobs.Bullfrog.name: Bullfrog

mobs.CorruptedDuck.description: Something wearing the shape of a duck, right up until it isn't.
mobs.CorruptedDuck.name: Corrupted Duck

mobs.Cyclops.description: One-eyed giants. Strength enough for ten.
mobs.Cyclops.name: Cyclops

mobs.Dryad.description: Pretentious magic users. They forget nothing.
mobs.Dryad.name: Dryad

mobs.Dwarf.description: Thick skinned and stubborn as stone.
mobs.Dwarf.name: Dwarf

mobs.Necromancer.description: Merchants of life, at a cost.
mobs.Necromancer.name: Necromancer

mobs.Pirate.description: Sea-raiders. Loyal to their crew, usually.
mobs.Pirate.name: Pirate

mobs.Salorian.description: Arctic dwellers. They survive where nothing should.
mobs.Salorian.name: Salorian

mobs.Satyr.description: Revelers and drummers. The wine never runs dry.
mobs.Satyr.name: Satyr

mobs.Skeleton.description: Those who stopped paying their debt.
mobs.Skeleton.name: Skeleton

mobs.Slaad.description: Amphibious folk of the deep marsh.
mobs.Slaad.name: Slaad

mobs.Strigoi.description: Once human, they live off the living.
mobs.Strigoi.name: Strigoi
